name: @autobroker/server
description: Layer 5 (app) — backend HTTP + SSE skill-run stream. Owns the embedded-host boot-recovery routine (telemetry kill -> deterministic tool re-registration -> suspended-run re-attach -> restart()/cancel() per age policy), the per-run SSE pubsub, the Mastra->product status projection, and the three-phase idempotent form-decision claim. Never imports @mastra directly (workflows-layer exports only) and never opens the product DB (tools closures only).
